scope: Two independently authored ordinary body paragraphs in one page. The observation checks preview-snapshot source paths and glyph geometry, not cell/object/story mapping, reading order, native shaping or cross-edit identity.
referenceTools: fontTools 4.61.1 with NotoSans-Regular.ttf sha256:b85c38ecea8a7cfb39c24e395a4007474fa5a4fc864f6ee33309eb4948d232d5; Poppler 24.02.0 pdftotext -bbox-layout in image sha256:a3aaef646226d406fc2b511462beb0359f4cd8859d775f404bd8f137dfd5f644; Open XML SDK 3.5.1 validator DLL sha256:4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec.
observation: Open XML validation found zero errors. The checker matched the two source paragraph paths, independently parsed each SVG glyph path and compared its font-unit bounds with fontTools' TrueType glyph bounds. It applied the SVG transforms and matched the snapshot glyph-box unions within 0.002 points, allowing the SVG's three-decimal coordinate rounding. Poppler's larger PDF word boxes enclosed the same glyph unions. Alpha snapshot bounds were [72,75.399,100.710,86.399]; Beta bounds were [73.067,90.887,94.605,98.851], in upper-left page coordinates. The SVG and snapshot bytes were reproduced in a second working-tree run.
earlierAttempts: The first focused compile failed because the measured-letter API used an obsolete property and an analyzer requested a concrete list type; both were corrected. An initial unsupported-owner test expected bookmark markers in the positioned-item list, but layout consumes them, so the corrected test checks the emitted paragraph's unavailable owner. A diagnostic-mapping test initially expected one item, while layout split the word into two positioned items; it now checks every fragment associated with that source location.
limitations: The DOCX, SVG, PDF and extraction files are scratch artifacts. Exact final-commit source/runtime/package and hosted qualification require separate checks. No public package is qualified by this working-tree observation.
